name: iEarn yUSDT hard-coded iUSDC accounting mismatch
summary: iEarn yUSDT was deployed with its Fulcrum lender set to bZx iUSDC instead of iUSDT, and its pool value counts that iToken as USDT. The attacker emptied the vault, donated iUSDC so rebalance burned it into USDC the pool value ignores, leaving pool value near zero against live supply, then deposited a little USDT for vast yUSDT and swapped it out of Curve pools.
notes: The iUSDC address is set in the constructor and set_new_FULCRUM was never called before the exploit; the 2020 set_new_COMPOUND change (cUSDC to cUSDT) is not on the exploit path and does not reset the age.

The campaign tx repeats the defect on the sibling iEarn yUSDT 0xe6354ed5 (Curve BUSD pool) and ycUSDT 0x1be5d71f (Curve PAX pool), both deployed with the same iUSDC constant. Later huge yUSDT mints are aggregator users routing through the broken price at roughly neutral value, not exploits.

Loss is gross depletion of the yToken backings drained through the Curve y, BUSD and PAX pools plus the PAX pool's USDP; yTUSD and yBUSD taken from the pools are valued at the attacker's redemption in the ref tx. Attacker USDC left in yUSDT is not subtracted.
